Description:

Experienced Supervisor (Rigger 1) is sought for port operations in Oxagon, Saudi Arabia. The role involves supervising lifting and rigging activities, cargo handling, and managing frontline teams within vessel, berth, and port operational areas. Key responsibilities include ensuring safety compliance, monitoring operations, and coordinating with shift superintendents. A minimum of 5 years of experience in port or terminal operations, with at least 3 years in a supervisory rigging role, is required. A valid Rigger 1 certification is essential.
